name: cfg-router-retry-limits
about: router 的重试与回退上限（router/config/parseRouterConfig.ts:155-320；router/policy/RouterRetryPolicy.ts；router/RouterRuntime.ts:733-920；router/fallback/runFallbackChain.ts:50-70）：fallback.default 给 fb1、fb2 两个回退但 maxFallbacks=1，只试 fb1；最后一个计划失败后按 transientRetry（maxAttempts=1、baseDelayMs=0、maxDelayMs=0，退避为 0 才能比 stderr 外的事件）再试一次；zeroUsageRetry.maxAttempts=2 时零用量空回复再请求一次后放弃。provider 的 streamMaxRetries=0 去掉流层重试。比较事件、provider 请求次数、router/events.jsonl 与会话记录。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/broken
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      retry:
        streamMaxRetries: 0
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        broken:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        fb1:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        fb2:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        zero:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        priced:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        baseline:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
router:
  enabled: true
  fallback:
    maxFallbacks: 1
    default:
      - bbx/fb1
      - bbx/fb2
  transientRetry:
    maxAttempts: 1
    baseDelayMs: 0
    maxDelayMs: 0
  zeroUsageRetry:
    maxAttempts: 2
